messages:
dana_sales: HelixMed asked for a tight POC: show 24h throughput + tail latency at their baseline (160 rps) and staged microbursts (up to 900 rps for 90s every 20m). They want a clear runbook, token cost estimate, and the minimal security checklist (SAML + privatelink). Can we confirm plan and timing?
rick_perf: Proposed plan: warmup/cache-fill 20m, steady 2h @160rps, burst block (90s@900rps every 20m for 6h), long-soak 12h @90rps. Capture p50/p95/p99, batch hist, queue time, gpu util, kv hits.
rick_perf: Runner example (dev harness): ```rbench --model redwood-13b-q4 --target https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate --qps 160 --concurrency 64 --duration 7200 --burst-pattern "900@90s:every20m" --warmup 1200```
nate_infra: Infra plan: two pools (steady + burst autoscaler), reserve 5 x a100-like nodes for window. Canary route to 7b-quant for automated fallback. Provisioning ETA 2028-02-14 09:00 PT -> 2028-02-15 09:00 PT.
emma_sec: Minimal shareable checklist: IdP metadata XML (SAML2), list of test admin users, corporate IPs for privatelink allowlist, desired region, BYO-HSM? (yes/no). We can do privatelink for 2-week trial and provide KMS-managed keys quickly. HSM adds onboarding.
oli_ae: Cost ask: token estimate for 24h run and delta if they take reserved baseline for 160rps vs on-demand. Need one-slide numbers for procurement.
rick_perf: Quick token math (est): assume 36 tokens/req avg. Tokens/hr = 160 * 36 * 3600 = 20,736,000. For representative 24h mix ~500M tokens. At $0.0007 per 1k tokens => token cost ~$350. Add compute/burst overhead ~15% => total run ~$402. Reserved baseline (monthly commit) would reduce unit price ~25%; bursts billed at on-demand with small premium.
perf-bot: [system] Sandbox provisioning request accepted: 5 x a100-sim nodes allocated to sales-sandbox for 2028-02-14 09:00 PT -> 2028-02-15 09:00 PT. Artifacts path: /shared/sales/helixmed/2178901234/
rick_perf: Tuning recs: batching.max_tokens=72, batching.max_wait_ms=8 steady; increase to 20ms in bursts. Warmup should use repeated prompts to warm KV cache. That reduces p99 substantially.
nate_infra: I'll enable prefix caching on the route and capture batch-size hist and queue depth. Also setting automatic fallback threshold: if p95 > 600ms for >3m, switch route to 7b-quant and alert.
emma_sec: Pasteable snippet for customer email: "We support SAML 2.0 (please provide IdP metadata XML), temporary privatelink (provide corporate IP ranges), KMS-managed keys by default. BYO-HSM supported with additional onboarding. SOC2 & ISO27001 attestation available on request."
dana_sales: Good. Can someone post a short slide-ready line with run plan + cost and the 99% POC uptime SLA we can promise? I'll include a rollback note.
oli_ae: Slide line: "24h POC: warmup 20m, 2h steady @160rps, burst cycles 900rps x90s, 12h soak. Estimated token cost ~$350 (run ~$402 incl bursts). POC uptime SLA: 99% during scheduled window. Automated fallback to smaller model if p95 breach persists >3m."
rick_perf: Running a quick 10m smoke now and will post p95/p99 in ~15m. If p99>500ms on smoke we will increase warmup and bump batching cap.
perf-bot: [system] Smoke completed: 10m steady @160rps -> p95=200ms, p99=440ms, kv_cache_hit=78%. Artifacts uploaded: /shared/sales/helixmed/2178901234/smoke.csv
nate_infra: Smoke looks healthy. I'll run burst soak with adjusted max_wait and upload results.
dana_sales: Thanks team 44d I'll send the customer email with run plan, cost slide, security snippet, and the 99% SLA once you upload the burst artifacts.
